intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Lake Worth, done right the first time
paragraphs: Pereira Construction of South FL handles bathroom remodeling in Lake Worth and across Palm Beach and Broward counties. Founder and CEO Robert Pereira has worked in construction for more than 25 years, from repairs and maintenance to remodels and new builds, and he has been a state Certified General Contractor since 2007.

The company's stated aim is simple: attention to detail and doing the job right the first time. Its Google reviews back that up. Homeowners write about tubs swapped for walk-in showers, moldy showers rebuilt, tile laid so the color patterns flow, and work areas kept clean and organized every day.

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling and Shower Conversions
items.blurb: Full bathroom renovations, tub-to-walk-in-shower conversions and shower rebuilds, including showers damaged by mold and water. Reviewers point to precise tile work, a clean job site and a finished look that matches the vision they started with.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a frameless glass walk-in shower, gray subway tile accent, a tiled shower bench and a wall-hung vanity

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Complete kitchen renovations like the one the crew finished in Delray Beach in summer 2023: white shaker cabinets, a waterfall-edge island, lit glass-front uppers, built-in wall ovens and wood-look plank tile running through the room.

image.alt: Kitchen renovation with white shaker cabinets, lit glass-front upper cabinets, a marble-look quartz backsplash, open shelves and a beverage fridge

items.name: Home Improvements, Repairs and Pavers
items.blurb: Beyond kitchens and baths, the company handles general repairs, interior and exterior renovations, swimming pools, and paver installation and repair of all types. Condo boards, HOAs and multifamily owners can also hire it for capital improvement projects.

about.h2: Founded and run by Robert Pereira
about.text: Robert Pereira is the Founder and CEO of Pereira Construction of South FL, Inc. He has more than 25 years in the construction industry and has been licensed by the State of Florida as a Certified General Contractor since 2007. Over that time he has worked on everything from maintenance and general repairs to remodeling and new construction, for both homeowners and commercial clients. Clients name him in reviews: one wrote that Robert and his team brought the bathroom she pictured in her head to life. The company's mission is to build lasting relationships on honesty, reliability and quality work.

service_area.h2: Working across Palm Beach and Broward counties
service_area.text: Pereira Construction is based in Lake Worth and serves all of South Florida, working mostly in Palm Beach and Broward counties. Recent videos on the site show bathroom renovations in Lake Worth and a kitchen renovation in Delray Beach. If you are not sure whether your town is covered, call or text and the team will let you know.

faq.h2: Before you hire a bathroom contractor in Lake Worth

items.a: Yes. Robert Pereira has been licensed by the State of Florida as a Certified General Contractor since 2007, and the company's license number is CGC1514600. Pereira Construction of South FL is licensed and insured, and it takes on both residential and commercial projects of all sizes.

items.q: Can you replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower?
items.a: Yes, and it is one of the jobs clients mention most. One recent reviewer had her bathtub replaced with a walk-in shower and said the tile was set so precisely that the color patterns flowed nicely, with a clean and organized work area throughout.

items.q: My shower has mold and water damage. Can you fix it?
items.a: The crew has rebuilt showers in that condition. One client wrote that her shower had mold and water damage and now looks brand new, and that the team was professional, on time and detail-oriented. Call or text a description and photos to start the conversation.
